configuration.title: Fix for Claude Code's New-Tab Auto-Splitting

claudeAutoSplitFix.enabled.description: Move a newly opened Claude Code tab into the preceding editor group when Claude creates a new split for it.

claudeAutoSplitFix.moveFileTabs.description: Also move a file that opens alone in a brand-new editor group — the layout Claude Code's sidebar file links produce — back into the previous group. A file already open in another group is never touched. Turn this off if you often use 'Open to the Side' on files not yet open anywhere; VS Code gives extensions no way to tell that apart from a Claude file link.

claudeAutoSplitFix.restoreDelayMs.description: Delay before correcting Claude's editor-group placement. Increase this if Claude recreates or relocks the split.

claudeAutoSplitFix.diagnostics.description: Record tab and group events in the Claude Auto-Split Fix output channel.
